headline.purpose: AI 回复标题和页面层级。

body.purpose: 普通界面说明和表单内容。

shadows.purpose: 能力菜单从页面内容上轻微浮起。

shadows.name: composer-capsule
shadows.purpose: 输入框上方操作胶囊的轻柔分层。

motion.name: capsule-state
motion.purpose: 操作胶囊展开时的透明度与旋转过渡。

components.name: 主要按钮
components.description: 用于明确的确认或提交操作，深色底配白字。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #24272C; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #70747C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .82; }

components.name: 次要按钮
components.description: 用于取消或次级动作，白底、细灰边框。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #D5D5D5; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #303134; font: 500 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F7F8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #70747C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #F2F2F2; }

components.name: 选择标签
components.description: 未选中时白底灰边，选中时深色底白字。
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D5D8DE; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #333741; font: 400 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip.is-selected { border-color: #24272C; background: #24272C; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #70747C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: 输入框
components.description: 多行补充说明；默认灰边，聚焦时边框加深。
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #555B62; font: 400 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field textarea { min-height: 72px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #D5D8DE; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #303134; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-field textarea:focus { border-color: #24272C; outline: 1px solid #24272C; }

components.name: 能力菜单面板
components.description: 白色浮层，用细边框和轻阴影从页面内容中区分。
components.css: .ds-menu-panel { width: 280px; padding: 16px 12px; border: 1px solid #E0E0E0; border-radius: 22px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #303134; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.04); font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-panel strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-menu-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #70747C; }

components.name: 操作胶囊
components.description: 输入区上方的短操作入口，轻微透白并有背景模糊。
components.css: .ds-action-capsule { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.84); border-radius: 13px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); color: #252932; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(23,33,43,.11); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font: 500 13px/1.1 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action-capsule:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #70747C; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: 小七的界面以黑、白、灰为主，让书籍和资料内容保持醒目。黑色用于主要操作和选中状态；白色留给工作区域；浅灰色用来区分背景、提示文字和边界。界面保持安静、清楚，减少装饰。\n\n手机和平板共用这套视觉方向。页面之间通过文字层级、留白和细分隔线建立结构，按钮、输入框和浮层都沿用同一组灰阶与圆角规则。
keyCharacteristics: 黑白灰为主，颜色只承担清楚的状态含义。
结构靠文字、间距和细边框表达。
阴影只用于需要浮起的菜单和操作胶囊。

rules.name: The Grayscale First Rule
rules.body: 优先用文字层级、留白和灰阶表达重点；只有错误或危险状态才使用红色。

rules.name: The System Sans Rule
rules.body: 界面文字沿用系统无衬线字体；代码片段使用等宽字体，阅读内容按阅读器设置显示。

rules.name: The Overlay Only Rule
rules.body: 静态内容优先保持平面；阴影只给需要从页面上浮起的操作层。

dos: Do use grayscale for ordinary surfaces, text, selection, and hierarchy.
Do use spacing and type weight before adding another visual accent.
Do keep inputs and menus readable with clear borders and focus states.
Do use static placeholders during route transitions; reserve small progress indicators for an action in progress.
donts: Don't add saturated accent colors or decorative gradients to ordinary screens.
Don't add heavy shadows to static cards or nest several card layers.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate errors or selection.
Don't use a loading spinner as a page transition.
